Vendored browser dependencies (downloaded 2026-11-27). Served locally, without runtime CDN requests.

- OpenCV.js 4.13.0: https://docs.opencv.org/4.13.0/opencv.js ; Apache-2.0, see opencv-LICENSE.txt. This build uses dynamic Emscripten bindings; eval is allowed only in the analysis Worker.
- fflate 0.8.2 UMD: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js ; MIT, see fflate-LICENSE.txt. ZIP uses stored entries, since JPEGs are already compressed.
